columns: id, name, host_id, host_name, neighbourhood_group, neighbourhood, latitude, longitude, room_type, price, minimum_nights, number_of_reviews, last_review, reviews_per_month, calculated_host_listings_count, availability_365
date_range: last_review: Berlin 2011-01-26 to 2017-05-08 (dump vintage ~2017-05-08); Vienna 2012-05-01 to 2017-09-14 (dump vintage 2017-09-15)
how_pulled: gh api repos/tmasjc/airbnb-market-data/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1; curl -sL -o <file> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tmasjc/airbnb-market-data/master/{Data/berlin.csv,Data/vienna.csv,download_csv.R,README.md}; python/pandas to describe
full_dataset_size: Whole repo ~12 MB: the two CSVs (4.86 MB, pulled in full), demo.gif 7 MB, Cache/webpage.xml 0.97 MB (2017 snapshot of insideairbnb.com/get-the-data.html listing every city and dump date then available), app.R/Dockerfile. Nothing else.
description: Two 2017 Inside Airbnb summary listings.csv vintages (Vienna 2017-09-15, Berlin ~2017-05-08), one row per listing with quoted price, room type, minimum nights, review counts and 365-day availability, committed to a Shiny demo repo. Also an R CLI (download_csv.R) that indexed the 2017 get-the-data page by city and dump date. For ABNB this is a pre-panel supply/quote-price snapshot for two regulated EMEA cities (Berlin Zweckentfremdungsverbot era, Vienna pre-2019 rules) — cross-sectional only, one dump each; an analyst would use it as a 2017 anchor for listing counts, review velocity and quote ADR versus our 2022-26 dumps. The downloader is reference-only: its scraper targets a page layout that no longer exists.
issues: Repo has no LICENSE file (data are Inside Airbnb, which publishes them as open/public). Downloader not run (third-party scrape; obsolete page structure). Berlin vintage date inferred from last_review max, not stated upstream. Summary listings only (no calendar/reviews files). The pull is the complete data content of the repo (nothing truncated), not a head sample.
